subject: Physics
b6_reason: Inside a uniform current-carrying wire the enclosed current grows as r^2 so B grows linearly with r; outside, the full current is enclosed and B falls as 1/r.
b6_working: Inside (r<R): B(2*pi*r) = mu0*I*(r^2/R^2) -> B = mu0*I*r/(2*pi*R^2), proportional to r. Outside (r>R): B(2*pi*r) = mu0*I -> B = mu0*I/(2*pi*r), proportional to 1/r.
b6_note: Option 3 text has a minor extraction blemish ('1 r dependence' instead of 1/r), but the intended meaning is unambiguous.
